open_points.subject: handle_list_records
open_points.text: - handle_list_records: [FIELD_PROJECTION] MUST show each listed record that another handler answers alone as that handler shows it: a TrialCase as handle_add_trial_case, a TrialExecution as handle_try_implementation, a NodeExecution as handle_get_repair_view, a FlowVersion as handle_compose_flow_version, an Implementation as handle_get_implementation and a Run as handle_start_run; a record whose ShownRecords field has the same type as the RecordSet field of the same name is listed unchanged, and a RecordSet field that ShownRecords lacks belongs to a type that is not listable and is never shown.
open_points.other_text: - handle_list_records: [FIELD_PROJECTION] MUST show each listed record that another handler answers alone as that handler shows it: a TrialCase as handle_add_trial_case, a TrialExecution as handle_try_implementation, a NodeExecution as handle_get_repair_view, a FlowVersion as handle_compose_flow_version, an Implementation as handle_get_implementation and a Run as handle_start_run; every other field of the RecordSet is copied into ShownRecords unchanged.
open_points.question: Must RecordSet fields absent from ShownRecords be omitted as the first passage requires, or copied unchanged as the second passage requires?

open_points.subject: handle_list_records effect-attempt projection
open_points.text: - handle_list_records: [FIELD_PROJECTION] MUST show an effect attempt as ShownEffectAttempt with every field of the EffectAttempt copied and its inputs passed through show_port_refs for the actor, never as the EffectAttempt itself (decision 24, A07 rule 4).
open_points.other_text: - handle_list_records: [FIELD_PROJECTION] MUST show each listed record that another handler answers alone as that handler shows it: a TrialCase as handle_add_trial_case, a TrialExecution as handle_try_implementation, a NodeExecution as handle_get_repair_view, a FlowVersion as handle_compose_flow_version, an Implementation as handle_get_implementation and a Run as handle_start_run; every other field of the RecordSet is copied into ShownRecords unchanged.
open_points.question: Must effect_attempts be converted to ShownEffectAttempt, or copied unchanged from RecordSet as EffectAttempt?

open_points.subject: handle_list_records approval projection
open_points.text: - handle_list_records: [FIELD_PROJECTION] MUST show an approval as ShownApproval with every field of the EffectApproval copied except preview, which becomes ShownApprovalPreview with service_id, operation_name and effect_class copied from the ApprovalPreview and its inputs and request as the security-boundary note of this handler says (A07, K-15).
open_points.other_text: - handle_list_records: [FIELD_PROJECTION] MUST show each listed record that another handler answers alone as that handler shows it: a TrialCase as handle_add_trial_case, a TrialExecution as handle_try_implementation, a NodeExecution as handle_get_repair_view, a FlowVersion as handle_compose_flow_version, an Implementation as handle_get_implementation and a Run as handle_start_run; every other field of the RecordSet is copied into ShownRecords unchanged.
open_points.question: Must approvals be converted to ShownApproval with a ShownApprovalPreview, or copied unchanged from RecordSet as EffectApproval?
